What BenchFlow sells

Builds practice tasks and tests for AI programs that carry out work. It also provides tools to run those tests.

  • SkillsBench — Tests whether reusable instructions improve agents’ task performance.
  • ClawsBench — Replicas of Gmail and Calendar, plus Docs, Drive and Slack, that retain changes between actions. Scores capability and safety separately.
  • Robo Use — Lets coding agents operate simulated robots through shell commands.
  • PostTrain Arena — Community environments tested using a fixed training recipe. Training runs are currently paused.
  • BenchFlow runtime — Open-source tools for running and scoring agents in test environments.
